Perfect! I can see the issue. The notification-worker is configured with `SMTP_HOST=smtp-relay` and is trying to look it up, but it's getting "no such host" error. The ticket mentions that smtp-relay was moved from the notify namespace to shared-infra on Sunday night. This means the old DNS name `smtp-relay` (which would be a short name referring to the service in the same namespace) no longer resolves because the service is in a different namespace now.
